answer: Sexual harassment; Theft, fraud, bribery or falsification of records, credentials or expense claims; Violence, threats or fighting at work; Working under the influence of alcohol or drugs; Intentional breach of data security or deliberate misuse of customer data; Illegal behaviour; Deliberate data theft or access to illegal content; Harassment. ZEN-POL-004 Progressive Discipline Policy (version 2, effective 2024-01-01). Section 8: Issues not subject to progressive discipline.
The following can lead to immediate suspension or termination, without earlier steps:
- Sexual harassment (investigated by the Internal Committee under ZEN-POL-008).
- Theft, fraud, bribery or falsification of records, credentials or expense claims.
- Violence, threats or fighting at work.
- Working under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
- Intentional breach of data security or deliberate misuse of customer data (ZEN-POL-006).
- Illegal behaviour, which may also be reported to the police.

ZEN-POL-005 Acceptable Use and Electronic Communication Policy (version 3, effective 2025-06-01). Section 10: Consequences of misuse.
Abuse or misuse of company technology leads to warnings or disciplinary action under the Progressive Discipline Policy (ZEN-POL-004), up to and including termination. Deliberate data theft or access to illegal content may lead to immediate termination.

ZEN-POL-001 Code of Conduct and Business Ethics Policy (version 3, effective 2024-04-01). Section 10: Consequences.
Breaches of this Code are handled under the Progressive Discipline Policy (ZEN-POL-004). Fraud, bribery, theft and harassment are not subject to progressive steps and may lead to immediate termination.

ZEN-POL-004 Progressive Discipline Policy (version 2, effective 2024-01-01). Section 6: Phase 3: Suspension and final written warning.
Used when temporary removal from work is the most effective action. The immediate manager may suspend an employee with pay pending an investigation when safety or evidence is at risk (up to 15 working days). Suspension as part of normal progression needs approval from the department head and the Head of People & Culture. Suspension without pay needs the CEO's approval and is limited to full-day increments. Pay is restored in full if the investigation clears the employee.

ZEN-POL-004 Progressive Discipline Policy (version 2, effective 2024-01-01). Section 7: Phase 4: Recommendation for termination.
The department head may recommend termination. The recommendation needs approval from the Head of People & Culture. For employees in band Z5 and above, the CEO gives the final approval. Termination may happen without earlier phases for serious misconduct.
